notes: Item 19 is fully disclosed with gross sales data for 33 Pestmaster franchises for the 12-month period ended December 31, 2025. Three sections: Section A (all franchises aggregate), Section B (by quartile), Section C (by tenure cohort). Only gross sales are reported; no profit, net income, or other financial metrics are disclosed. Figures represent Gross Sales, not profits. 11 franchises excluded for not reporting full 12 months. OCR quality is good with minor ambiguity resolved by context (e.g., Franchise #4 gross sales shown as $1,048,484 in Section B First Quartile but $1,048,483 in Section C — likely rounding; used disclosed values as-is per section). Tenure cohort schema labels are approximate fits for the 1-5 year and 5-9 year and 9+ year buckets.
